assumptions.signalExecution: Indicator evaluated and filled at completed timeframe candle close
assumptions.futures: BANKNIFTY index point P&L x 30, Rs 362 estimated round-trip cost
assumptions.options: Black-Scholes ATM proxy, IV 20%, spread 3 points/side, Rs 80 cost; modelled, not historical premium
assumptions.validation: Positive 2021-2024 train, 2025-2026 validation and 2026 recent; validation PF >= 1.08; >=55% profitable months; net profit > max drawdown

OPTIONS.methodology: Selected 15-minute indicator signals on BANKNIFTY with modelled ATM option premiums (Black-Scholes, 20% IV), spread and estimated costs.
